name: Data Lakes
certifications: Microsoft Certified: Fabric Data Engineer Associate

beginner.summary: For analysts, developers and junior data engineers who know basic SQL and have used a cloud console or command line but have not built a data lake. Covers object storage mechanics on S3, ADLS Gen2 and GCS, bucket and prefix layout, raw file formats, Parquet internals and compression, Hive-style partitioning, querying files in place with DuckDB and Athena, the Glue Data Catalog, schema drift, medallion zones, Spark batch ingestion and cleaning, small-file compaction, IAM access control, encryption and lifecycle rules, cost awareness, and a clickstream lake capstone.
prerequisites: Writes SQL SELECT, JOIN and GROUP BY queries and basic Python or PySpark
Uses a terminal and the AWS CLI, or has a MinIO or LocalStack sandbox, with permission to create buckets
Has an AWS account or equivalent S3-compatible storage, DuckDB and Spark available for labs
outcomes: Design a bucket, prefix and partition layout for raw, cleansed and curated data
Build a Bronze, Silver and Gold pipeline in Parquet with PySpark and register it in the Glue Data Catalog
Query lake data with DuckDB and Athena and explain bytes scanned and cost
Secure a lake with least-privilege IAM, KMS encryption, versioning and lifecycle rules
